title: Haram
what_detected: Ingredient classified as Haram detected. See BOTIA Note below for details.
why_it_matters: Under Islamic Law, certain sources are explicitly forbidden — including pork and its derivatives, alcohol, blood, and food additives derived from any of these sources (Codex CAC/GL 24-1997). When BOTIA classifies an ingredient as Haram, the origin is clear and declared on the label.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only. It cannot issue a religious ruling or replace a certified Halal authority.
